faqs.a:
An employee who is facing a life-threatening illness, injury, or domestic violence
               situation may apply for additional sick leave from the sick leave bank provided all
               other leaves have been exhausted. The creation and employee use of the sick leave
               bank is governed by a policy established by the city manager.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023;
Ord. No. 4890
, § 10, 2-10-2025)
